review:
Fire my Laser ditches traditional wins altogether. Two types of bomb and two types of laser destroy symbols on the grid, and every paying symbol destroyed pays according to the paytable, with blank symbols paying nothing. Destroyed symbols trigger cascades, and new bombs or lasers can be set off by other explosions.

All wins go into a Total Win Bar and are paid at the end of the spin. Bombs and lasers fire in a set order, from the bottom up and right to left. It's a sci-fi demolition game with a 15,000x ceiling, and one of the strangest designs in the catalogue.
